changelog: v1.0.2: universal WebUI bridge adapter — auto-detects and drives three manager bridge flavours: sync JSON exec/execWithOptions (rushiranpise Shizuku-Next, Shevery), async callback ShizukuNext.exec/execScript (yijiacloud Shizuku Next enhanced edition, incl. its temp-copy script pipeline), plus filesystem probe fallback for moduleDir. Startup now prints [diag] fingerprint lines (bridge keys, moduleDir) into the console so any residual incompatibility is visible at a glance. v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release — GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
